links.outcome: Expert-rated validity of chatbot answers to endodontic FAQs at lenient and strict thresholds
links.effect: Low threshold: both models 95% validity (95% CI 75.1%-99.9%). High threshold: ChatGPT-4o 35% (15.4%-59.2%), Gemini Advanced 40% (19.1%-63.9%), p=1.
links.quote: At the low threshold, both models obtained 95% validity (95% CI: 75.1%- 99.9%; p=.05).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the validity/accuracy of ChatGPT-4o and Google Gemini Advanced responses to patient FAQs in endodontics using specialist Likert scoring, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
